components.name: Accordion
components.notes: Radix dependency installed in repository; rules summaries in room creation currently use visual cards and tabs instead of inline accordions.

components.name: Alert
components.notes: Official shadcn Alert with brass, destructive, emerald variants. Used in JoinInvitePage, DisconnectRecovery, and testing.

components.name: Alert Dialog
components.notes: Official shadcn AlertDialog primitive wrapping Radix. Used for match forfeit confirmation in LobbyPage and GamePage.

components.name: Aspect Ratio
components.notes: Playing cards use precise Tailwind aspect-ratio `aspect-[2/3]` to match physical card geometry. Radix primitive available.

components.name: Attachment
components.notes: Multiplayer card game has no user attachment upload requirements; assets are strictly deterministic and server-controlled.

components.name: Avatar
components.notes: Official shadcn Avatar primitive wrapping Radix. Used in PlayerSeat, PlayerCard, and Lobby roster.

components.name: Badge
components.notes: Official shadcn Badge with brass, emerald, purple, destructive variants. Used in CreateRoomModal, LobbyPage, and DashboardView.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.notes: Semantic header navigation path (`Dashboard / Room Code`) with accessible chevron separators in LobbyPage.

components.name: Bubble
components.notes: Tailwind-styled chat speech message bubbles with player color chips and timestamp alignment.

components.name: Button
components.notes: Official shadcn Button with default (crimson), brass, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost variants across all screens.

components.name: Button Group
components.notes: WAI-ARIA compliant segmented button group (`role="group"`, `aria-label="Player capacity"`, `aria-pressed`) for player capacities.

components.name: Calendar
components.notes: Digital card game has no booking or calendar scheduling features.

components.name: Card
components.notes: Official shadcn Card with CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter. Used in DashboardView, JoinInvitePage.

components.name: Carousel
components.notes: Card hands use horizontal responsive overlapping flex-wrap with scroll fallback; carousel pagination is unsuitable for rapid hand play.

components.name: Chart
components.notes: Game scoring uses tabular rankings and point breakdowns; time-series or analytic charts are not applicable.

components.name: Checkbox
components.notes: Integrated via DropdownMenuCheckboxItem and custom accessible toggle switches.

components.name: Code Block
components.notes: No developer code blocks or syntax-highlighted code blocks exist in card room.

components.name: Collapsible
components.notes: Radix dependency installed. Chat uses a sliding drawer (Sheet pattern) rather than an inline layout-shifting collapsible.

components.name: Combobox
components.notes: Mutually exclusive 7-variant selection uses visual preview cards; combobox search is unneeded.

components.name: Command
components.notes: Spotlight/Cmd-K search palette is not appropriate for a dedicated card game table.

components.name: Context Menu
components.notes: Installed dependency. Context menus are disabled on game cards to preserve instant tap/click responsiveness.

components.name: Data Table
components.notes: End-of-match score standings table with rank columns, point differentials, and player identities.

components.name: Date Picker
components.notes: No date input requirements exist in the multiplayer gaming loop.

components.name: Dialog
components.notes: Official shadcn Dialog primitive wrapping Radix. Powers CreateRoomModal, JoinRoomModal, MatchResultModal.

components.name: Direction
components.notes: Radix DirectionProvider configures document text RTL/LTR. PlayDirectionIndicator handles clockwise/counter-clockwise game flow.

components.name: Drawer
components.notes: Framer Motion animated slide-out side drawer for in-game multiplayer chat and system logs.

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.notes: Official shadcn DropdownMenu primitive wrapping Radix. Used for user profile actions and lobby room settings.

components.name: Empty
components.notes: Empty state illustration and typography in ChatPanel ('No messages yet') and empty lobby slots.

components.name: Field
components.notes: Accessible form field pattern linking Label, Input, validation state, and helper text via ARIA.

components.name: Hover Card
components.notes: Installed dependency. Compact Tooltips are preferred over large HoverCards to avoid obstructing adjacent player seats.

components.name: Input
components.notes: Official shadcn Input primitive. Used in GuestLoginForm, JoinRoomModal, and ChatPanel.

components.name: Input Group
components.notes: Input merged with trailing submit button in ChatPanel and formatted room code input in JoinRoomModal.

components.name: Input OTP
components.notes: Official shadcn InputOTP primitive wrapping input-otp with defensive slot context fallback.

components.name: Item
components.notes: Semantic list items in player rosters, dropdown items, and card action menus.

components.name: Kbd
components.notes: Monospace keyboard shortcut indicator badges ('Enter' to send, 'Esc' to close).

components.name: Label
components.notes: Official shadcn Label primitive wrapping Radix. Used across GuestLoginForm, CreateRoomModal, and modals.

components.name: Marker
components.notes: Active turn highlight ring and brass arrow pointer identifying current active player.

components.name: Menubar
components.notes: Desktop app menubar is inappropriate for full-screen board game web applications.

components.name: Message
components.notes: Chat message item with sender attribution, formatted timestamp, and system event styling.

components.name: Message Scroller
components.notes: Auto-scrolling container pinned to bottom on incoming message updates in ChatPanel.

components.name: Native Select
components.notes: Rich game variant preview cards with badge chips and rules summaries are used instead of a plain native select.

components.name: Navigation Menu
components.notes: Header navigation bar linking Dashboard, Room info, and profile controls.

components.name: Pagination
components.notes: Card hands use horizontal responsive flex-wrap; game sessions display cumulative single-table results.

components.name: Popover
components.notes: Official shadcn Popover primitive wrapping Radix. Used for card rule popovers and player details.

components.name: Progress
components.notes: Turn timer currently uses SVG circular countdown rings; linear progress bar primitive is available for secondary progress indicators.

components.name: Questionnaire
components.notes: Card gaming platform has no multi-step questionnaires or user surveys.

components.name: Radio Group
components.notes: Game variant selector implements WAI-ARIA `role="radiogroup"` with `role="radio"` and `aria-checked`.

components.name: Resizable
components.notes: Game board uses automatic CSS grid and viewport-adaptive proportions rather than split panes.

components.name: Scroll Area
components.notes: Official shadcn ScrollArea wrapping Radix. Powers smooth chat scrolling and overflowing card hands.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Installed dependency. Variant picker uses full visual cards with rich rules content rather than a closed dropdown select.

components.name: Separator
components.notes: Official shadcn Separator primitive wrapping Radix. Used in LobbyPage, ChatPanel, and modals.

components.name: Sheet
components.notes: Slide-out right sheet panel for multiplayer chat and in-game notification logs.

components.name: Sidebar
components.notes: Collapsible right-side felt panel housing real-time messaging.

components.name: Skeleton
components.notes: Subtle dark slate pulsing skeleton containers (`animate-pulse bg-white/5 rounded-xl`) for pre-load states.

components.name: Slider
components.notes: Official shadcn Slider built on @radix-ui/react-slider with brass thumb, matte track, and keyboard accessibility. Used in AudioSettingsControl for analog volume control.

components.name: Spinner
components.notes: Official shadcn Spinner with warm amber Lucide Loader2, aria-label, role='status'. Used in Suspense and button submission.

components.name: Switch
components.notes: WAI-ARIA accessible toggle switch (`role="switch"`, `aria-checked`) for UNO Attack customizable cards.

components.name: Table
components.notes: Accessible HTML table elements (`table`, `thead`, `tbody`, `th`, `td`) with tabular figures for match results.

components.name: Tabs
components.notes: Official shadcn Tabs wrapping Radix. Powers variant rules tab switching and settings views.

components.name: Textarea
components.notes: Official shadcn Textarea primitive. Used for multi-line chat and bug report dialogs.

components.name: Toast
components.notes: In-game table notification banners and alert overlays replace floating toast stacks to avoid card occlusion.

components.name: Toggle
components.notes: Player ready state toggle button with instant optimistic UI feedback.

components.name: Toggle Group
components.notes: Segmented player capacity controls grouping buttons under `role="group"`.

components.name: Tooltip
components.notes: Official shadcn Tooltip wrapping Radix. Used on UnoButton, action buttons, and card information hints.

components.name: Trace
components.notes: Distributed tracing visualization is not applicable to digital card game client.

components.name: Typography
components.notes: Custom typography system combining Cormorant Garamond / serif display headings with Inter body and tabular mono scores.
